metadata.description: Validation test for Altitude Hold (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T16): AUX4 at mid before the throttle is raised does not engage; after a climb it engages at 4 s and holds near the entry altitude with the stick at hover; full stick climbs at about 5 m/s; low stick stops the target moving and the quad holds. Default Betaflight gains, so the hold is underdamped (about ±2 m).
